baseline_models.focus_anchor: ران على قلوبهم ... ما كانوا يكسبون links r-y-n over q-l-b directly to habitual k-s-b.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeatedly sought gain becomes reflexive: acquisition settles over the inward faculty as an overpowering condition from which its agent cannot disengage. The temporal construction makes ryn a formed state, not a single spot.

activation_trace.role: The no-exit condition makes ryn an entrapping state rather than merely a visible film.
The heart as inward understanding locates the entrapment in discernment and response.
Being or occurrence in time lets repeated earning consolidate into an enduring condition.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the ironic material that becomes harmful to its seeker.

changed_reading.before: Their bad acts leave a stain on their hearts.
changed_reading.after: What they repeatedly pursue as benefit becomes a self-acquired no-exit state governing their inward understanding.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rare verb ran is predicated over qulub and explained by what they kept earning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ryn can be the settling dominance of drowsiness or wine in head, eye, or heart. The focus therefore supports functional incapacitation: practice does not merely mark the faculty but progressively alters how awake and responsive it is.

activation_trace.role: Settling drowsiness or wine supplies an overpowering, perception-altering mode for ryn.
The inward faculty is the site whose understanding becomes dulled.
Temporal predication supports habituation rather than a single intoxicating event.
Repeated benefit-seeking functions as the self-administered source of altered discernment.

changed_reading.before: Ryn is a passive moral coating.
changed_reading.after: Their habitual acquisitions act like settling drowsiness or intoxication, lowering the wakefulness of the faculty that should understand.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ran and qulub permit a somatic-core reading, while kasb supplies an acquired material analogy.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nauseated-self branch shifts ryn from an exterior layer to inward revulsion. Read with the heart as pure core and kasb as extract, what is acquired is analogically processed into the core until the self turns foul; the extract image is material scaffolding, not a lexical gloss of yakسبون.

activation_trace.role: The self becoming foul and nauseated gives ryn an embodied inward reaction.
The pure core makes the change qualitative at the center, not superficial at the edge.
An extracted substance supplies a deliberately exploratory analogy for acquisitions becoming assimilated residue.

changed_reading.before: Misdeeds discolor an otherwise unchanged interior.
changed_reading.after: Their acquisitions are assimilated into the core until the self itself turns foul and cannot inwardly stomach what confronts it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange pattern specifies the kind of earning that forms ryn: quantified self-advantage is secured by transferring deficiency to others. The inward result can therefore be read as a counter-account in which apparent outward surplus trains and diminishes the faculty of equitable response.

activation_trace.role: Benefit-seeking anchors the commercial action as the focus ayah's causal material.
The acquired advantage hardens into a self-binding condition with no easy exit.
Measuring food makes acquisition concretely quantified rather than generically immoral.
Fullness without deficiency marks the amount demanded for the self.
The balance of justice supplies the norm that the exchange reverses.
Causing deficiency in measure identifies the outward loss imposed on the counterparty.

structural_cues: 83:2-3 reverse transaction direction: full intake for self, deficient output to others; 83:14 makes their earning act back upon their own hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured asymmetry, fullness, just balance, imposed deficiency, and self-seeking gain; I infer that transferred deficit returns as inward deficit. A live alternative is simple accumulation with no amount-for-amount counter-account.

changed_reading.before: Any repeated wrongdoing can produce an undifferentiated inward accretion.
changed_reading.after: The ryn is the agent's inward counter-account: each profitable asymmetry toward others simultaneously deforms the capacity to measure and reciprocate justly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired written and numbered records activate an internal-record reading. What is fixed in an external register is also lived as a durable mark in the core: ryn is the embodied counterpart of the record produced by earning, without collapsing the heart into the book.

activation_trace.role: The no-exit state gives the inward record persistence and binding force.
The heart as core locates the record's lived effect inside the agent.
Fixing something so that it entails judgment turns writing into consequential determination.
A numbered or inscribed line supplies the external ledger image.
A branded bodily mark bridges external inscription and an effect carried by a living subject.

structural_cues: The book-numbered formula appears at 83:7-9 and again at 83:18-20, placing the focus diagnosis between mirrored records.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed records, inscription, bodily marking, and a self-earned condition over the core; I infer an external-record/internal-trace correspondence. The alternative is that the books are solely forensic while ryn is an unrelated psychological effect.

changed_reading.before: The record of acts exists outside the actor, while the heart merely suffers a stain.
changed_reading.after: Earning writes two coexisting records: a numbered public account and a binding inward inscription carried by the actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prison before the focus and barred access immediately after it expand the no-exit ryn into a layered topology. The earned condition first confines the inward faculty; the following barrier then presents relational non-access as the outer counterpart or culmination of that inner confinement.

activation_trace.role: Being caught without a way out is the focus-level interior confinement.
The inward faculty is the chamber in which self-confinement operates.
Confinement in a place supplies the enclosing spatial frame before the focus.
A severity that fixes like imprisonment sharpens the model from location to immobilized state.
Prevention of arrival supplies the immediately subsequent loss of access.
A concealing barrier materializes the separation outside the inward faculty.

structural_cues: 83:7-9 gives prison and record, 83:14 locates a no-exit state over hearts, and 83:15 immediately states barred access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three constraint images in sequence; I infer that self-earned inward confinement matures into relational exclusion. A live alternative treats prison, ryn, and barrier as separate sanctions sharing only atmosphere.

changed_reading.before: Ryn is an inward blemish followed by a separate punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their earning constructs an inner confinement whose outward horizon is non-arrival: the barrier after the focus is the spatial completion of the no-exit heart-state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence supplies a cognitive micro-mechanism: an evident sign is encountered, converted by speech into a settled doctrine of false tales, and followed by ryn. The drowsiness/wine branch makes this repeated reclassification function like self-sedation of the inward faculty.

activation_trace.role: Settling drowsiness or wine models the reduced responsiveness produced by repeated dismissal.
The inward faculty is what the speech-practice progressively incapacitates.
The lying self makes denial a recurrent producer within the agent, not only an isolated false sentence.
A manifest sign supplies the perceptible input that is being reclassified.
Speech as belief or doctrine lets the utterance organize perception rather than merely report it.
The false-tales category is the interpretive label repeatedly placed over the signs.

structural_cues: 83:13 has a conditional encounter-response sequence and 83:14 begins with corrective rejection, making ryn answer that exact reclassification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign, doctrinal utterance, false-tales label, and then ryn; I infer a causal loop in which repeated labeling sedates discernment. The alternative is a purely forensic diagnosis after denial, with no psychological mechanism asserted.

changed_reading.before: Denial is evidence that an already-coated heart cannot see.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also an operation that produces the coating: each spoken reclassification of a sign rehearses and deepens perceptual sedation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sustained drink-and-mixture sequence activates a metabolic rather than surface model. Ryn as settled wine or nausea and kasb as extract can be read analogically as what repeated action introduces into and assimilates through the inner constitution; the pure chosen drink is a counter-image, not proof of identity.

activation_trace.role: Settled wine gives the focus state an ingested, perception-altering material mode.
Fouling nausea supplies the bodily consequence of a corrupted inner intake.
Extracted fat or oil supplies a cautious analogy for acquired material being processed and retained.
Watering the heart with something disliked explicitly connects administered substance and inward effect.
Pure selected wine supplies the contrasting form of an inwardly received drink.
Bodily mixture and constitution shifts the analogy from coating to composition.
Admixture in color and heart directly supports a change carried into the inner faculty.

structural_cues: 83:25-28 sustains sealed drink, finish, mixture, spring, and drinking rather than mentioning beverage only once.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ryn-wine/nausea, extract, heart-watering, bodily mixture, heart admixture, and a pure drink sequence; I infer assimilation of practice into inner constitution. The live alternative is that the later drink is reward imagery with no backward activation of 83:14.

changed_reading.before: Earned acts deposit an exterior film on the heart.
changed_reading.after: Earned practice is taken into the person like a mixture and alters the heart's composition, while the later pure drink offers a coexisting counter-model of wholesome assimilation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later verbal use of q-l-b turns the focus noun into motion: after repeated passing and ridicule, they turn back twice toward their belonging group and enjoy speech about others. The heart's capacity to turn is thus socially routed into return to the same validating circuit, making ryn a feedback loop as well as an accretion.

activation_trace.role: Turning and reversal expose dynamism inside the focus word usually read only as the organ.
The loop's repeated return explains how a turnable faculty becomes difficult to escape.
A temporal occurrence and repetition makes the mocking encounter a rehearsed pattern.
The doubled turning-back action externalizes repeated reversal in the same root as hearts.
Return and destination identify the in-group as the recurrent terminus of that turning.
Nearness and belonging supply the social enclosure that confirms the pattern.
Making sport of reputations supplies the pleasurable group practice that rewards return.

structural_cues: 83:30-31 runs encounter, gesture, doubled return, belonging, and amused talk as a repeatable social circuit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, two q-l-b return forms, belonging, and ridicule; I infer that group reward routes the inward faculty back into its prior orientation. The alternative is a literal return home with no model of heart formation.

changed_reading.before: Private acts independently accumulate over a private inner organ.
changed_reading.after: Ryn is also socially maintained: the faculty keeps turning back into a belonging-and-ridicule loop that rewards the very earning by which it is trapped.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending joins acquisition, offense, action, and recompense-as-return. This activates an immanent reading of 83:14: before final judgment, action has already begun returning to its actor by becoming a state over the heart; later recompense is a further return, not the first consequence.

activation_trace.role: Self-acquisition makes the focus consequence belong to what the actors themselves obtain.
Return and destination make the heart a first destination of the actor's own practice.
The returned yield is already binding the actor before the final scene.
Acquisition within the offender root creates a lexical bridge between crime and earning.
Offense and culpability keep that acquisition morally specified rather than financially neutral.
The recompense of work returning to its worker supplies the explicit terminal return.
Producing an act names the work whose yield comes back to its producer.

structural_cues: 83:29 names the offenders with a root that also branches to acquisition, while 83:36 closes by asking about recompense for what they used to do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition/offense, action, returned recompense, and a focus consequence caused by earning; I infer that ryn is the first return of action to actor. The alternative confines all recompense to the final external event and treats the inward state as merely evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: The heart-state records wrongdoing now, and recompense arrives only later.
changed_reading.after: The heart-state is already a returned yield of action: judgment later completes a reflexive process that earning has begun inside the earner.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later barrier and covering branches make concealment reciprocal across the sequence. The agents cover truth; what they earn comes to dominate their inward faculty; then access is covered from them. This coexists with the prison model but emphasizes epistemic reciprocity rather than spatial enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Settling dominance over the heart explains how active covering can become impaired reception.
The inward understanding is the middle surface across which covering changes direction.
A concealing barrier supplies the immediate outward counterpart after the focus.
Covering names the agents by the concealment they practice.
Covering the truth specifies the epistemic object initially hidden by them.

structural_cues: Repeated denial precedes 83:14, barred access follows at 83:15, and the same agents are later named by a covering root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth-covering, inward dominance, and a concealing barrier; I infer a reversal from covering by the agent to covering from the agent. The alternative is that these are independent uses of concealment language without reciprocal causality.

changed_reading.before: Their hearts are covered and they are later barred, both as one-way penalties.
changed_reading.after: Concealment reverses direction: the practice of covering truth becomes impaired inward access and finally a barrier covering access from the coverers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because heart-as-casting-mold is a form-distant q-l-b branch and record/seal images do not prove that qalb means mold here; it remains valid because the focus branch directly anchors the image and context independently supplies engraving and stamping. Render only as an as-if material model, not a lexical replacement for heart.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qulub directly carries the casting-mold branch, while ryn is attributed to repeated earning.

activation_trace.role: The casting mold allows the core to be imagined as taking a durable form from repeated inputs.
The no-exit condition supplies rigidity once the form has set.
Engraving and patterned marking supply repeated material shaping.
Stamping with a seal and leaving its impression supplies the finalizing material action.

changed_reading.before: Acts add removable material onto a stable heart.
changed_reading.after: Repeated acts may be imagined as casting and stamping the core into a durable form, so ryn names deformation of shape rather than only added surface matter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the hunting-creatures sense of kasb and the struck-heart sense of q-l-b are cross-domain and not the ordinary syntax of the focus; it remains anchored in two direct focus branches and is activated by measured loss and crime-as-acquisition. Render as a predation analogy: outward taking recoils as inward injury.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yakسبون supplies the predatory-earners branch and qulub supplies the struck-heart branch within the focus itself.

activation_trace.role: Predatory or hunting creatures called earners recast acquisition as taking from vulnerable others.
Hitting the heart turns the apparent winner's predation into an inward wound.
Shorting measure provides the concrete prey-making economic act.
Crime's acquisition branch keeps predation tied to the surah's language of gaining.

changed_reading.before: Earning benefits the actor while incidentally staining an inner organ.
changed_reading.after: Their earning behaves like predation: the outward taking that injures others simultaneously lands as a wound in the hunter's own inward faculty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the livestock-loss ryn branch is highly specific and the focus does not mention herds; it remains directly anchored in ran and is activated by imposed loss plus a context branch where livestock is wealth. Render as a restrained social-economic echo: a gain-producing collective becomes inwardly bereft, not as a claim that livestock is the focus referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ran directly carries the state of a people made bereft by livestock loss, while the focus assigns that state to what they earn.

activation_trace.role: Collective bereavement through lost livestock shifts ryn from individual stain to a depleted social condition.
Seeking material benefit creates the irony of gain producing bereavement.
General loss supplies the harm exported by the gain-seeking practice.
Livestock as wealth keeps the bereavement image inside the packet's material economy, though only analogically.

changed_reading.before: Ryn is an exclusively private defect in each offender.
changed_reading.after: The exploitative mode of earning can also be heard as collective bereavement: a group that appears to gain has made itself inwardly and socially depleted.

strongest_changes: The commercial opening changes generic moral accumulation into a reflexive counter-account: outwardly transferred deficiency becomes inward loss of equitable measure.
Prison, barrier, record, and inscription make ryn coexist as self-confinement and an embodied ledger rather than one vague stain.
The sign-speech sequence makes denial both symptom and producer of perceptual sedation, while the social return sequence shows how a group rewards and renews it.
Crime-as-acquisition and recompense-as-return make the heart-state an early returned yield of action; the drink-and-mixture model remains a separate exploratory account of assimilation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's rare r-y-n inventory supports no-exit, sedation, nausea, and collective loss, while q-l-b and k-s-b open turning, molding, predation, and extraction. Ordered context cues activate these into several inspectable mechanisms that should coexist rather than be merged into one final gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammar supplies earning as cause of ryn, but a feedback arrow in which ryn then enables further earning remains inferred rather than explicit.
External record, prison, barrier, drink, and return may be deliberate mechanism-level echoes or only analogical context activators.
The casting, predation, extract, and livestock readings are branch-backed but form-distant; they require explicit exploratory qualification in downstream prose.
